heading: top-center
name: 跨界置中標題＋圖片卡片輪播與頁碼控制
desc: 置中的標題組跨在與上一個區塊的交界上；下方是一次露出四個項目的輪播，每個項目以一張橫式圖片開頭，底部置中放左右箭頭與頁碼。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊本身不往上移，只有標題組往上移，跨在本區塊和上一個區塊的交界上：小標籤落在上一個區塊的範圍內，大標題的第一行壓在交界線上。本區塊要有自己的實色底色，而且和上一個區塊的底色不同（例如淺色底），交界線才看得出來；區塊上方用區塊內的上方留白（不是外距，也不是負邊距）容納往上移的標題組，這段留白的底色和上一個區塊相同、不能透明，整個區塊從上到下都不能透出底下的內容，也不能蓋到上一個區塊的內容。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放副標，沒有時省略；大標題明顯大於項目的標題。標題組下方是輪播，對齊頁面內容寬度，桌機一次露出四個項目、不露出下一個項目，可用箭頭切換。每個項目無外框：上方是一張橫式圖片；下方是標題（可多行），標題下方靠右放一段次要文字，同一列左側可放小標籤，接著可放說明文字，最後是按鈕，沒有時省略。同一排的項目等高，標題長短不同時，次要文字和按鈕仍對齊在同一高度。輪播下方置中放一組控制：左箭頭按鈕、目前頁碼與總頁數（兩個數字之間一條短橫線）、右箭頭按鈕。
tablet: 平板沿用桌機版，一次露出的項目數量減少。
mobile: 輪播改為橫向滑動，邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分：一次露出一個項目，約佔畫面寬的八成並靠左對齊頁面內容寬度，右側露出下一個項目的一部分，延伸到畫面右緣。項目內的組成不變。標題組仍置中，大標題仍跨在與上一個區塊的交界上。下方控制的左右箭頭按鈕分居兩側，頁碼置中。可用手指左右滑動切換。

en.name: Boundary-straddling centered heading + image card carousel with page counter
en.desc: A centered heading group straddles the boundary with the previous section; below it is a carousel showing four items at a time, each starting with a single landscape image, with left and right arrows and a page counter centered underneath.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section itself is not pulled up; only the heading group is moved up so it straddles the boundary between this section and the previous one: the label sits within the previous section and the first line of the headline lies on the boundary line. This section has its own solid background color that differs from the previous section (for example a light tint) so the boundary is visible. The raised heading group sits in this section's own top padding (not an outer margin and not a negative margin); that padding uses the same background color as the previous section and is never transparent, so nothing underneath shows through anywhere in the section and nothing covers the previous section's content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a subheading below; omit them when there is no content. The headline is noticeably larger than the item titles. Below the heading group is a carousel aligned to the page content width; on desktop it shows four items at a time without revealing the next item, and is switched with arrows. Each item has no border: at the top is a single landscape image; below it is a title (may wrap to multiple lines), with secondary text aligned right below the title, optionally a label on the left of that same row, then optionally a description, and finally a button; omit them when there is no content. Items in the same row are equal in height, so even when titles differ in length, the secondary text and buttons stay aligned at the same height. Centered below the carousel is a set of controls: a left arrow button, the current page number and total page count (with a short line between the two numbers), and a right arrow button.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout, with fewer items visible at a time.
en.mobile: The carousel becomes horizontally swipeable, with part of the next item showing at the edge: one item is visible at a time, taking about eighty percent of the screen width and aligned left with the page content width, while part of the next item shows on the right, extending to the right edge of the screen. The composition of each item stays the same. The heading group stays centered, and the headline still straddles the boundary with the previous section. In the controls below, the left and right arrow buttons sit at the two sides with the page counter centered. Items can be switched by swiping left and right.
